rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/compound beginning with gandha and akṣata; qualifying puṣpāṇi
objects to be employed in worship

items.question: Which specific substances and flowers must be employed in this ritual offering?
premises: The ritual requires offerings including fragrance and unbroken rice.
Flowers are among the substances to be employed.
The flowers to be used must be red.
items.inference: Therefore, one should employ red flowers together with fragrance, unbroken rice, and similar offerings.
uncertainties: The exact range of items included by ādi is not specified.
items.plain_english: One should employ red flowers, along with fragrance, unbroken rice, and other such offerings.
